_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE. `series`: market series whose resolution rules I have verified against the lane model's inputs, keyed by the `series` field strategy/tools/lanes.py prints (lane + question with numbers blanked; devig: league + shape). Record what the market resolves on (price source, window, touch vs close, timezone), how that maps to the model inputs, and when I checked. `excluded`: series the model must not price for now, with the reason and an `until` date (e.g. a barrier_equity series whose window contains an earnings release). `lanes.py plan --verified-only` uses verified series only and always skips excluded ones. Remove a verified entry the moment a settlement shows the mapping was wrong.

devig:cfb:moneyline.source: Polymarket resolves to the team that wins the game, OT included, tie->50-50 (moneyline, no draw in practice)
devig:cfb:moneyline.window: single game, commence_time from the book event
devig:cfb:moneyline.note: checked description on market 4802819 (Texas vs. Tennessee); matches devig lane's who-wins-the-game model

barrier:Will Silver (XAGUSD) hit (HIGH).note: checked 4884190; vol source is 30d realized vol from SI=F daily closes (252-day annualized) combined with touch.py's calendar-day time input (365) - a small (~3-4%) annualization mismatch over a full-month window, judged acceptable; see journal/proposals.md for a possible trading-day-count fix
barrier:Will Silver (XAGUSD) hit (HIGH).operator_note: the 252-vs-365 clock mismatch this entry flags was fixed in lanes.py the same day (realized-vol underlyings now count weekdays over 252)
